launchpad.headline: Understand how your project's files and modules connect.
launchpad.subline: Trace module dependencies, investigate coupling, and review architectural findings with the evidence behind each one.
launchpad.localDesc: Analyze a directory on this machine. Files are read only when you start a scan.
launchpad.githubDesc: Analyze a public repository via HTTPS. The temporary clone is removed after analysis.
launchpad.demoDesc: A multi-language project with circular dependencies and hotspots ready to inspect immediately.
launchpad.footSecurity: Read-only analysis. Repository code never executes.
launchpad.footCoverage: Coverage limits stay visible in every report.

summary.actionCycle: Inspect circular dependency cycles in the graph to break tight coupling.
summary.actionGod: Examine large oversized files in the Inspector to plan cohesive refactoring.
summary.actionClean: Architecture is healthy. Explore modules or review the transparency report.
summary.actionLowCoverage: Language coverage is partial. Dependency cycles cannot be ruled out.

graph.showingModules: Showing {{files}} modules and {{edges}} directed dependency edges
graph.showingPackages: Showing {{packages}} package clusters and {{edges}} directed dependency edges

inspector.title: Selected Module Inspector
inspector.noSelectionDesc: Click any node on the interactive dependency graph or choose a file in the Explorer to inspect its AST imports, stability metrics, and architectural findings.
inspector.noCycles: No circular dependency violations for this file.
inspector.noTriggeredRules: No health rule violations triggered by this module.

report.title: Explainable Rule-Based Architecture Health Report
report.lowCoverageExplanation: The majority of this repository's code uses languages or frameworks where AST dependency resolution is incomplete. Missing dependencies are not treated as evidence of clean architecture.
report.noFindings: No architectural rule violations were triggered. All evaluated structural rules passed successfully.

onboarding.title: RepoDNA Quick Guide
onboarding.step1Desc: Start with your local workspace, any public GitHub repository, or explore the preloaded demo architecture in one click.
onboarding.step2Desc: The summary strip displays your project's overall score, circular dependencies, and language coverage confidence.
onboarding.step3Desc: Zoom, pan, and select modules or package clusters. Edges show how files import each other with directional flow.
onboarding.step4Desc: Click any file or package to see its role, stability, and actionable engineering recommendations in the Inspector.

help.fanInDesc: Number of other modules that import or depend on this file. High Fan-In modules are core providers.
help.fanOutDesc: Number of other modules this file directly imports. High Fan-Out modules are orchestrators that depend on many parts.
help.instabilityDesc: Measures resilience to change. 0.00 is completely stable (depended upon, depends on nothing). 1.00 is volatile.
help.sccDesc: Groups of modules mutually reachable through dependency chains, detected using Tarjan's algorithm.
help.circularDesc: A mutual dependency loop between two or more modules (e.g. A → B → A) violating the Acyclic Dependencies Principle.
help.astCoverageDesc: Percentage of source code parsed with Tree-sitter abstract syntax trees for verified static dependency extraction.
help.confidenceDesc: Confidence rating based on language support and verified coverage. Repositories with partial coverage are flagged honestly.
